title: Submit a verification request for your account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to submit a verification request for your Business Center account or ad account. After you have submitted a verification request, you can monitor your approval progress using [/account/verification/status/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/check-the-verification-status-of-your-account/v1.3). ## Before you begin Ensure you have already uploaded your verification documents via [/account/verification/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-verification-documents/v1.3) and have your `qualification_image_ids` ready. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/submit/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{35%}|Type{15%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/marketing-api-authentication/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed value: `application/json`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{34%}|Data Type{11%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {+Conditional}|string|Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` has to be set.

The ID of the ad account that you want to submit a verification request for.
  • If you are submitting your own verification document, you need to hold admin or operator access to the ad account. You can verify this access by using [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-assets/v1.3), passing `ADVERTISER` as the `asset_type`, and ensuring the `advertiser_role` returns `ADMIN` or `OPERATOR`.
  • If you are reusing a verification document from others, you need to have the proper permissions:
    • To reuse a verification document from another ad account, you need to have admin or operator access to the ad account. Verify this via [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-assets/v1.3) (pass `ADVERTISER` as `asset_type` and ensure `advertiser_role` is `ADMIN` or `OPERATOR`).
    • To reuse a verification document from another Business Center account, you need to have admin access to the Business Center account. Verify this via [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and ensure the `user_role` returns `ADMIN`.
| |bc_id {+Conditional}|string|Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` has to be set.

The ID of the Business Center account that you want to submit a verification request for.

You need to have admin access to the Business Center account.

If you want to a verification document from another Business Center account, you need to have admin access to the Business Center account. Verify this via [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and ensure the `user_role` returns `ADMIN`.| |business_form {+Conditional}|object|Either `business_form` or `individual_form` has to be set.

Details of your business verification information.

Specify this field if you want to submit a business verification request.| #|company_name {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The business name.

The business name you specify here must exactly match the name on your verification documents. You cannot change your business name after the verification is complete.

Length limit: 128 characters.| #|website_url {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The URL of the company website.

Length limit: 512 characters.| #|industry_code {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The industry category that your business belongs to.

Enum values:
  • `NOT_APPLICABLE`: Not applicable.
  • `ALCOHOL`: Alcohol.
  • `OTC`: OTC.
  • `DATING_APP`: Dating app.
  • `FINANCIAL_SERVICES`: Financial services.
| #|region_iso_code {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The country or region code for your business (Business Center account or ad account), in ISO 3166 format.

Example: `US`.

  • To retrieve the country or region code of your Business Center account, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and check the returned `registered_area` parameter.
  • To retrieve the country or region code of your ad account, use [/advertiser/info/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-ad-account-details/v1.3) and check the returned `country` parameter.
| #|file_type_code {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The code of the verification document.

To obtain the code of a verification document available for your business, use [/account/verification/filetype/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-available-verification-document-types-for-a-region/v1.3).| #|license_no {+Conditional}|string|Required when `business_form` is specified.

The certificate number of your verification document.

Make sure the number you specify here is the same as the number on the document. It can’t be changed after submission.

Length limit: 128 characters.| #|qualification_image_ids {+Conditional}|string[]|Required when `business_form` is specified.

A list of qualification image IDs for business verification documents.

You need to specify exactly one ID.

To obtain the qualification image ID of a business verification document, use [/account/verification/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-verification-documents/v1.3).| |individual_form {+Conditional}|object|Either `business_form` or `individual_form` has to be set.

Details of your individual identity verification information.

Specify this field when you want to submit an individual identity verification request.| #|individual_name {+Conditional}|string|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

Full legal name.

The name you specify here must exactly match the name on your verification documents. You cannot change the name after the verification is complete.

Length limit: 128 characters.| #|region_iso_code {+Conditional}|string|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

The country or region code for your business (Business Center account or ad account), in ISO 3166 format.

Example: `US`.

  • To retrieve the country or region code of your Business Center account, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and check the returned `registered_area` parameter.
  • To retrieve the country or region code of your ad account, use [/advertiser/info/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-ad-account-details/v1.3) and check the returned `country` parameter.
| #|file_type_code {+Conditional}|string|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

The code of the verification document.

To obtain the code of a verification document available for your business, use [/account/verification/filetype/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-available-verification-document-types-for-a-region/v1.3).| #|identity_no {+Conditional}|string|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

ID number.

Make sure the number you specify here matches the number on your government issued ID (driver's license, passport, etc.) This can't be changed after submission.

Length limit: 128 characters.| #|website_url {+Conditional}|string|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

The URL of the company website.

Length limit: 512 characters.| #|qualification_image_ids {+Conditional}|string[]|Required when `individual_form` is specified.

A list of qualification image IDs for personal identification documents.

You need to specify exactly two IDs, representing the front image and the back image.

To obtain the qualification image ID of a personal identification document, use [/account/verification/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-verification-documents/v1.3).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/submit/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "business_form": { "company_name": "{{company_name}}", "website_url": "{{website_url}}", "industry_code": "OTC", "region_iso_code": "US", "file_type_code": "{{file_type_code}}", "license_no": "{{license_no}}", "qualification_image_ids": [ "{{qualification_image_ids}}" ] } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
